description: Cache implementation missing stampede protection — should warn or block
outcome: Cache expensive product catalogue queries in Redis
design: On cache miss, fetch from database and write to Redis with a 5-minute TTL. No locking strategy.

oracle_evidence.key_insight: Redis cache without stampede protection caused DB overload during peak traffic
oracle_evidence.decision: Redis cache without stampede protection caused DB overload — all cache misses hit DB simultaneously during spikes
